versions.subject: Detects Obfuscated Powershell via use Rundll32 in Scripts
versions.detection:
selection_1:
    EventID: 4104
selection_2:
    - ScriptBlockText|re: '(?i).*downloadstring&&.*rundll32.*powershell.*(value|invoke|comspec|iex).*"'
selection_3:
    EventID: 4103
selection_4:
    - Payload|re: '(?i).*downloadstring&&.*rundll32.*powershell.*(value|invoke|comspec|iex).*"'
condition: ( selection_1 and selection_2 ) or ( selection_3 and selection_4 )
versions.spl: | rex field=ScriptBlockText "(?<ScriptBlockTextMatch>(?i).*downloadstring&&.*rundll32.*powershell.*(value|invoke|comspec|iex).*\")" | eval ScriptBlockTextCondition=if(isnotnull(ScriptBlockTextMatch), "true", "false") | rex field=Payload "(?<PayloadMatch>(?i).*downloadstring&&.*rundll32.*powershell.*(value|invoke|comspec|iex).*\")" | eval PayloadCondition=if(isnotnull(PayloadMatch), "true", "false") | search (EventID=4104 ScriptBlockTextCondition="true") OR (EventID=4103 PayloadCondition="true")
